_about: SO-101 leader/follower teleop kit. Edit only if the owner tells you to.
servo: Feetech STS3215, 6 per arm, IDs 1-6 = shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper

leader.note: leader is read-only (torque always off); its 5 V bus cannot drive the servos and that is intended

follower.note: limits live in the servo EEPROM; this copy is only used to warn if the EEPROM differs

_eeprom_snapshot_note: Owner: run 'python3 -m so101 snapshot' with both arms connected before shipping. The check command then verifies the servos still carry the owner's calibration.
